definitions.explanation: A lizard known for changing its skin color, for its long sticky tongue, and for eyes that move separately. Also used of a person who changes opinions or style to suit the situation.

examples.japanese: カメレオン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
カメレオン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舌|した}→舌：02154_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばして→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|と}った→捕る：28715_toru⟧。
examples.english: The chameleon shot out its tongue and caught an insect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まったく⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、カメレオン⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: He shows a completely different face in every role, so people call him a chameleon actor.

notes:
The figurative use is usually neutral or admiring of actors and performers (カメレオン⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧), but critical of politicians who change sides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カメレオン⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change color like a chameleon
- カメレオン⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: an actor of great range
